lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Ca2 (Mg6Ca) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 14 atoms per unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca centers with 12 Mg neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Mg centers exhibit 12- and 11-neighbor environments, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 3.07–3.55 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra and Ca-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
